title: Multi-window residual trees, quota selection and event-aware learning

data_files.format: UTF-8 CSV; header; decimal point; no row index

endpoint_id.meaning: Lead-window key; integer lower and upper day bounds are inclusive.

proposed_id.meaning: Method on the positive side of the reported paired difference.

comparator_id.meaning: Method subtracted from the proposed method.

comparison_family.meaning: Prespecified comparison family; intervals use the adjustment defined in Supplementary Methods S5.

difference_pp.meaning: Proposed coverage minus comparator coverage, or lake-relative minus absolute-target training as specified for this file.

lower_pp.meaning: Lower endpoint of the paired whole-lake bootstrap interval for this difference.

upper_pp.meaning: Upper endpoint of the paired whole-lake bootstrap interval for this difference.

bootstrap_replicates.meaning: Number of valid whole-lake bootstrap replicates used in the interval.

confidence_level.meaning: Interval coverage level: 0.95, 0.975 or 0.9875. Multiply by 100 for a percent label.

data_files.format: UTF-8 CSV; header; decimal point; no row index

category_id.meaning: Composition-category key; categories are mutually exclusive within each bar.

count.meaning: Count in this mutually exclusive composition category.

total.meaning: Shared denominator for this composition bar.

data_files.format: UTF-8 CSV; header; decimal point; no row index

episode_id.meaning: Opaque independent-event key. Preserve as a string; each key denotes one event within the specified cohort.

lake_id.meaning: Opaque lake identifier; preserve as a string. Not a plotted numerical variable.

event_date.meaning: Date of the first high-value record of the independent event.

event_year.meaning: Calendar year of the first high-value record.

event_order.meaning: One-based event column in the chronological ordering: date then lake ID then episode ID.

method_id.meaning: Stable method key; display the associated method label, not the key.

covered.meaning: Whether this method selected the lake in at least one eligible opportunity of the stated lead window.

method.meaning: English method label; order XGBoost, Elastic Net, Single-window, Multi-window.

episode_id.meaning: Opaque independent-event key. Preserve as a string; each key denotes one event within the specified cohort.

lake_id.meaning: Opaque lake identifier; preserve as a string. Not a plotted numerical variable.

event_date.meaning: Date of the first high-value record of the independent event.

method_id.meaning: Stable method key; display the associated method label, not the key.

method.meaning: English method label; order XGBoost, Elastic Net, Single-window, Multi-window.

first_lead_days.meaning: Largest lead time in 1–60 days at which this event was selected. Empty means no selection within 1–60 days.

earliest_category.meaning: Mutually exclusive earliest-selection category: 31–60 d, 15–30 d, 1–14 d, or Uncovered.

data_files.format: UTF-8 CSV; header; decimal point; no row index

method_id.meaning: Stable method key; display the associated method label, not the key.

method.meaning: English method label; order XGBoost, Elastic Net, Single-window, Multi-window.

lead_days.meaning: Lead-day cutpoint d; the cumulative series counts events first selected at least d days before the event.

events_selected_by_lead.meaning: Number with first_lead_days >= lead_days in the fixed 681-event 1–60-day cohort.

cohort_events.meaning: Fixed event denominator for this complete data series, independent of lead-day cutpoint.

cumulative_coverage_pct.meaning: 100 × events_selected_by_lead / cohort_events. This is not endpoint-specific 31–60-day coverage.

data_files.format: UTF-8 CSV; identifiers are strings; method indicators are booleans.

episode_id.meaning: Independent-event key; exact join to primary fingerprint.

lake_id.meaning: Lake identifier, retained as a string.

event_date.meaning: ISO date of first high record.

xgboost.meaning: True if covered by XGBoost in the primary 31–60-day window.

elastic_net.meaning: True if covered by Elastic Net.

same_window_control.meaning: True if covered by the Same-window control.

missing_values: Empty first_lead_days means no selection within 1–60 days and stays in the 681-event cohort. Empty schematic fields mean no illustrative observation. Other plotted empirical values are complete.
